scope: HKBWS Hong Kong List 2024 coverage only; not worldwide expert-source coverage
source_acquisition: official_page_search_cache_fragments; direct HTML GET and full PDF acquisition unsuccessful
limitations: List contains only Hong Kong category I/II birds; not all 11131 species.
Blank IUCN cells are not LC and are not interpreted as any grade.
Different cached fragments can retain spelling variants; exact-name coverage is lexical, not proof of taxonomy concept equivalence.
Source table release/update dates are not individual assessment years.
All apparent conflicts are retained; no runtime grades overwritten.
Runtime comparison uses saved actual DB rows replay; not fresh live DB/API verification.
Official taxonomy decision name candidates require individual expert account and taxonomic evidence review.
584 list rows were recovered, but the full set of 584 species-account conservation sections was not acquired. Only individually reviewed accounts have excerpt evidence.
